episode.title: The Hundred Years War Actually Lasted 116 Years

synopsis: Despite its famous name, the medieval war between the ruling houses of England and France lasted 116 years.

title_card.title: The Hundred Years War lasted 116 years.
title_card.subtitle: The medieval conflict raged from 1337 to 1453.

caption:
The Hundred Years' War actually lasted 116 years.

The royal dynasties of England and France fought this legendary conflict from 1337 until 1453. Spanning over a century, the war redefined European warfare, siege tactics, and feudal kingdom boundaries.

Visuals created with AI.

Did you know this conflict spanned over a full century?
